name: GDG Jerez de la Frontera
shortDescription: Comunidad tech que conecta a profesionales, estudiantes, makers y entusiastas de toda la provincia de Cádiz para aprender, compartir y colaborar mediante charlas, talleres, networking y eventos sobre desarrollo, IA, cloud y otras tecnologías.

shortDescriptionI18n.en: A tech community connecting professionals, students, makers and enthusiasts from across the province of Cádiz to learn, share and collaborate through talks, workshops, networking and events on development, AI, cloud and other technologies.
